description: Alterations to porch canopy; Two storey rear infill extension; Installation of solar panels to rear roof slope; Roof light to rear roof slope; Replacement doors and windows in rear elevation
decision_conditions:
<p>The development hereby permitted shall not commence until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces noted below have been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority:
(a) the extension to show type and brickwork bond and arrangement of the bricks; </p><p>(b) details of front elevation showing showing paint of timber panels and window arrangement.&nbsp;</p>
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

<p>The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:&nbsp;</p><p>225138/01 Rev A, 225138/02 Rev B, 225138/03, Classic Casement Fixed Sash: Sash Clip Head / Cill Section, Classic Casement Side Hung Transom Detail, Classic Casement Side Hung Jamb Section, Classic Casement Fixed Sash: Sash Clip Jamb Section, Classic Casement Side Hung Head / Cill Section, Classic Casement Side Swing Transom Detail, Design and Heritage Statement for extension and alterations works to Middle Cottage, Little Common, Stanmore, Material Specification (Mumford &amp; Wood), CIL Form 1, Form 4 – Reasonable Exception Statement&nbsp;</p>

<p>No replacement of the windows on the front elevation shall take place until detailed drawings of the proposed windows have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details shall include existing and proposed elevations and sectional drawings at a scale of 1:10 or 1:20 and shall demonstrate that the replacement windows match the design, proportions, profile, opening method, glazing arrangement and finish of the existing windows. The windows shall thereafter be installed and retained in accordance with the approved details.</p>
